description: A C extension wrapping macOS CoreMIDI: list MIDI devices, entities, sources and destinations, follow an external MIDI clock (Start, Clock, Stop, Continue, Song Position) through hooks on a Client subclass, and schedule timestamped notes with CoreMIDI's host-time scheduler. macOS only.

author: StupidCodeFactory <ymarquet@gmail.com>
description: Archaeopteryx is a live coding environment for MIDI: write clips and instruments in Ruby, start a session with `arcx start`, and edit the files while it plays in time with an external MIDI clock. It drives macOS CoreMIDI through the rcoremidi gem.
